name: Sharp & Son
greeting: Sharp & Son, you're through to the AI assistant on this demo line. Who are you booking with?
summary: Sharp & Son is a barber shop in Kirkhill: Traditional barbering and wet shaves.
core_facts: Sharp & Son: Traditional barbering and wet shaves, at 3 Mill Yard (example), Kirkhill.
Tuesday to Friday: 8:30am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 8:30am till 2pm. Closed Monday and Sunday.
Barbers: Ray (forty years with the razor); Tom.
A £10 deposit secures a booking and comes off the price. Free to cancel or move with 48 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.

services.label: Classic cut
services.description: Scissors and clippers, finished with a neck shave.

services.label: Beard trim
services.description: Shaped, lined up and finished with oil.

services.label: Hot towel shave
services.description: A traditional straight-razor shave with hot towels.

knowledge.q: How much is a cut? What are your prices?
knowledge.a: Classic cut £20 (30 minutes); Beard trim £12 (20 minutes); Hot towel shave £20 (30 minutes).
Classic cut: Scissors and clippers, finished with a neck shave. About 30 minutes, £20.
Beard trim: Shaped, lined up and finished with oil. About 20 minutes, £12.

knowledge.q: What is a hot towel shave?
knowledge.a: Hot towel shave: A traditional straight-razor shave with hot towels. About 30 minutes, £20.

knowledge.q: Which days does each barber work?
knowledge.a: Ray: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday (Saturday 8:30am to 12 noon). Tom: Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.
Ray: Forty years with the razor.
We're appointments only, so please book a time.
Yes.
Yes: the same services at the same prices as anyone, a short back and sides or a fade included.

knowledge.q: Do you do Afro and textured hair?
knowledge.a: Yes: any of our barbers.

knowledge.q: Is there a charge for paying by card?
knowledge.a: No: there's no extra charge for paying by card.

knowledge.q: What if I need to cancel or move my booking?
knowledge.a: A £10 deposit secures a booking and comes off the price. Free to cancel or move with 48 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.
Up to 5 minutes late is fine; later than that we may need to move you to the next free time.

knowledge.q: What if I'm not happy with my cut?
knowledge.a: Let us know and the owner will call you back to put it right.

knowledge.q: Do I need a skin test for colour?
knowledge.a: We don't do colour.
Step-free from the street, with room for a wheelchair at every chair. Ask for a quiet time and we will book one.
There's no parking at the shop: the Lace Market and Victoria Centre car parks are a few minutes' walk.
We sell the wax, clay, oils and beard balm we use in the shop.
Tips are welcome, and the barbers keep all of them.

knowledge.q: I was cut or nicked by the razor and it is still bleeding
knowledge.a: Sorry to hear that. If it's still bleeding, press on it with something clean for ten minutes. If it won't stop, or it's deep, call NHS 111 or go to A&E. We'll take a message for the owner.
We're always happy to hear from barbers and apprentices: drop your details in, or leave a message.
Ray visits care homes on Mondays: leave a message to arrange.
Ray does, with a day's notice.
